queue.topic: Elderly parents in India and NRI children abroad (USA, Canada, UK): Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act 2007 tribunals and maintenance, revoking gifts and transfers made to children, caretaker and tenant verification, powers of attorney and healthcare decisions, protecting the parents' home from encroachment, and what an NRI child can and cannot do from abroad. Do NOT duplicate the existing guide on revoking gift deeds; link to it.

NRIs as directors, shareholders and founders of Indian companies and LLPs: resident director requirement (182 days) under Section 149(3) Companies Act 2013, DIN and DIR-3 KYC, FEMA and FDI reporting for NRI investment, designated partner rules for LLPs, board meetings and signing from abroad, bank accounts. Link to existing FDI and DIR-3 KYC guides; do not repeat them.

Remote property purchase by NRIs from USA, Canada and UK: title due diligence step by step, what the registry and revenue records prove, encumbrance and mutation checks, litigation search, common title defects and fraud patterns in Delhi NCR, Punjab, Haryana and Kolkata, escrow and payment trail under FEMA. Do not repeat the existing NRI property purchase FEMA guide; focus on title and due diligence.

Money lent or invested by NRIs in India with relatives and friends: recovery routes (legal notice, Order XXXVII summary suit, Section 138), limitation, documentary proof of loan, bank-channel and FEMA rules on loans between NRIs and residents, security and interest, informal arrangements that fail in court.

Marriage registration and validity for NRIs and spouses abroad: registering under the Hindu Marriage Act or Special Marriage Act (notice period), marriages solemnised abroad and their recognition in India, registration for spousal visa applications to USA, Canada and UK, proof of marriage, second marriage and bigamy risks, and remedies for a deserted spouse. Link to existing look-out circular, foreign divorce and alimony guides; do not repeat them.

Correcting name, date-of-birth and record discrepancies that block NRI transactions in India: mismatches between passport, Aadhaar, PAN, bank and property records, affidavits and gazette name change, civil-court declaration, correction in revenue and registry records, birth and death certificate corrections, and what each remedy is accepted for.

Managing Indian property while living abroad: rent agreements and collection, tenant default and eviction under State rent laws, caretakers and property managers, property tax, utility and society transfers, insurance, protection against encroachment, and the documents an NRI landlord should hold. Do not repeat the existing guides on illegal occupation recovery.
